title: Query-prior stress test for CUB 200-way 1-shot transduction
dependency: PAT-K-260729-004 selected LaplacianShot lambdas; all other constants remain fixed

regimes.MILD_3_9: 100 classes retain 3 queries and 100 retain 9, permuted by a fixed seed; mean count 6
regimes.SEVERE_1_9: 22 copies of counts 1..9 plus two count-5 classes, permuted by a fixed seed; mean count 5

data.subset_rule: within class, take the lexicographically first remaining image IDs after the fixed class-count permutation

arms: DCTPR with its original uniform query prior
DCTPR with oracle class counts as a diagnostic upper control
signed PT-MAP with uniform and oracle class counts
metrics: delta from the corresponding balanced episode
interpretation: diagnostic stress test only; it cannot change DCTPR or published-baseline hyperparameters
forbidden: Do not tune class-prior estimators on stress labels
Do not call oracle-prior controls deployable methods
Do not hide a prior-mismatch failure
